THE OPERATING MODEL

Give every stage a purpose. Give every handoff an owner.

Generate Demand. Capture Interest. Qualify. Develop. Measure. Each stage has a defined responsibility, a useful next action and an outcome to review.

THE MARKEVANCE SYSTEM

One connected system for demand, pipeline and growth.

We bring marketing and sales development together so that every stage supports the next.

Marketing → Sales Development

  2. 02Capture Interest
  3. 03Qualify

Each stage supports the next.

  1. 01Generate Demand

    Get discovered by the right market.

    We use paid acquisition, search, content and targeted outreach to put your company in front of the businesses or customers most likely to need what you sell.

    Capabilities at this stage
    • Google Ads
    • Meta Ads
    • LinkedIn
    • SEO
    • AEO
    • GEO / AI Search
    • Content
    • Outbound prospecting

  2. 02Capture Interest

    Turn attention into identifiable opportunity.

    Landing pages, conversion paths, forms and tracking systems help turn anonymous interest into actionable leads.

    Capabilities at this stage
    • Landing pages
    • Conversion optimization
    • Lead forms
    • Tracking
    • Retargeting
    • Conversion paths

  3. 03Qualify

    Not every lead deserves your sales team's time.

    We help identify which prospects match your business, understand their requirements and prioritize opportunities with real commercial potential.

    Capabilities at this stage
    • Lead qualification
    • Company research
    • Requirement discovery
    • Lead scoring
    • CRM management

  4. 04Develop

    Move qualified prospects toward a real conversation.

    Where appropriate, Markevance can support prospecting, outreach, calling, follow-up and appointment booking as an extension of your growth team.

    Capabilities at this stage
    • Cold outreach
    • LinkedIn outreach
    • Email outreach
    • Remote calling
    • Follow-up
    • Appointment setting
    • Fractional SDR

  5. 05Measure

    Know what's creating pipeline.

    We connect acquisition activity with meaningful business metrics so decisions can move beyond vanity numbers.

    Capabilities at this stage
    • Qualified leads
    • Meetings booked
    • Opportunities
    • Conversion rates
    • Cost per qualified lead
    • Pipeline value
    • Customer acquisition cost
    • Revenue attribution where available

Establish fit before adding sales pressure.

FROM DIAGNOSIS TO ITERATION

A working rhythm with clear ownership.

Scope and review cadence are agreed for each engagement. A useful report answers what happened, why it matters and what changes next.

  1. 01

    Discovery

    Understand the product, audience, capacity, sales cycle, existing channels and the owner’s commercial objective. Identify the information and access needed to make a useful diagnosis.

  2. 02

    Strategy

    Choose the priority bottleneck, customer profile, channel approach and scope. Agree stage definitions, responsibilities and measures before execution.

  3. 03

    Execution

    Connect campaign messages, content, landing pages and enquiry handling. Keep work focused on the agreed priorities instead of increasing activity everywhere.

  4. 04

    Qualification

    Check fit and interest, document the conversation and assign the next action. Separate a raw enquiry, a qualified lead, a booked meeting and a client-confirmed opportunity.

  5. 05

    Reporting

    Review sources, qualified leads, meetings and opportunities. Report revenue only where attribution is supportable, and explain missing data and limitations.

  6. 06

    Iteration

    Use the evidence to change targeting, messages, landing pages or follow-up. Record what changed, why it changed and what the next review should establish.

What the client brings

Accurate product or programme information, relevant access, a decision maker, sales or counselling capacity and feedback on lead outcomes. No agency can replace those responsibilities with campaign volume.
